status: analysis exploration lock; not a model; no version assigned
purpose: replace Harville-derived quinella/wide probabilities with ticket-specific strict-OOS market-residual classifiers
trainingRows: every official ticket with available official odds; no synthetic or derived odds
target: whether the ticket is a winning payout combination
features: pre-race pair features already frozen before the race, including paired horse history/context features, official ticket odds, normalized official ticket market probability, and strict-OOS horse probability features

marketPrior.quinella: normalized inverse official odds, race mass 1
marketPrior.wide: normalized inverse official lower-bound odds, race mass 3

model.type: LightGBM binary residual model with official ticket market probability logit as init_score

ticketScore: strict-OOS ticket hit probability multiplied by JRA official odds (wide uses official lower bound)
